scope: The production generation publisher ran in an isolated child process. The process was hard-terminated after a generated stub was linked into a new generation and before its completion manifest was written. A fresh official VS Code host then reopened the disposable workspace.
limits: The killed child used a small VS Code API double around the production publisher; the recovery and Pylance checks ran in the pinned official host.
This bounded crash-recovery case does not complete issue #24 or the broad live-typing gate.
